name: ux-prototype

gates.description: Requirements defined and approved before prototype work begins

metadata.description: Define the UX problem, gather requirements, sketch concepts

gates.description: Prototype renders in browser without errors
Mock data is realistic and representative

metadata.description: Build standalone HTML prototype with design system aesthetics and mock data

gates.description: UX quality approved before implementation begins

metadata.description: From approved prototype, extract data model needs, API endpoints, and component structure

parameters.name: designSystem

parameters.name: mockDataSpec
parameters.description: Description of what mock data to generate for the prototype

parameters.name: reviewCriteria
parameters.description: Specific UX criteria to evaluate during review

parameters.name: prototypePath
parameters.description: Output path for the generated HTML prototype file
